root_idea.summary: The root centers on coolness as opposed to heat, with related branches of stillness or fixity, clothing, and movement or transmission.
root_idea.development: From coolness, the lexicon develops meanings of relief and ease, sleep and stillness, settled or fixed states, hail and cold-bearing things, garments, and the movement of messengers along a route.

senses.definition: Cool; having a low temperature or providing relief from heat.
senses.usage_conditions: An adjective or substantivized participle applied to things such as water, shade, or air.

senses.definition: Hail: frozen rain or ice descending from clouds.
senses.usage_conditions: A collective noun for hail or hailstones.

senses.definition: Coolness or cooling relief from heat.
senses.usage_conditions: In 21:69 it denotes cooling or relief. One reported interpretation of 78:24 understands بَرْدًا as the coolness of a beverage rather than sleep.
In 78:24, بَرْدًا is explained as sleep, understood as a state of bodily cooling or stillness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cold, chill, or cool; for a thing's heat to subside.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb, including the use of water or other things that become cool.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go on a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use, literally describing a place of sleep or rest becoming cold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the extinction of bodily heat or motion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become still, quiet, or motionless; to become easy or assuaged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to people, beverages, pains, or affairs according to context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sleep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use associated with cooling and stillness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, become permanent, or become fixed and settled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of death becoming fixed upon a person or its signs becoming apparent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become established as incumbent, owed, or due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a right, obligation, or sum fixed against someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become weak, languid, lean, or emaciated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes weakness from hunger, fatigue, disease, or loss of bodily substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become blunt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a sword or similar cutting instrument.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or render something cold or cool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to water, a heart, an eye, or other objects; the derived Form II may express intensification. It can also mean mixing something with snow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To relieve, ease, or lessen a burden, discomfort, or punishment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes figurative uses such as relieving an animal from riding or alleviating punishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To moisten bread by pouring water over it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The water is understood to be cold or cooling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To file or rasp iron and similar material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action is performed with a مِبْرَد, a file.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send someone as a post messenger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived use connected with a بَرِيد, a messenger or post conveyance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an obligation incumbent or established against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form II use of fixing or settling a due.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To weaken or render weak and languid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II causative or intensive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a locust to spread its wings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use referring to the locust's بُرْدَان, or wings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter a cool period or wait until the heat has abated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of entering the cooler part of the day or season and of delaying food or the noon prayer until then.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a cold or cool drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV construction with a recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring something cold or cool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV transitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cool oneself by entering water and washing in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action is undertaken for refreshment through contact with coolness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become weak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed or specialized figurative use of Form V.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cool oneself with cold water; to wash, drink, or pour water over oneself for cooling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may focus on washing, drinking to cool the liver, or pouring water over the head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To use one's tongue against someone like a file: to annoy, hurt, or revile him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form X construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasantness, enjoyment, ease, or comfort.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the relief provided by coolness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Saliva.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare attributed lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or striped woollen wrap worn around the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may denote the garment collectively or an individual garment; several traditional varieties are named.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rich man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression, literally referring to possession of a garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe dispute or vehement altercation in which garments are figuratively rent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression for arriving at a grave or intense state of affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act alike, agree, or become closely united.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic comparison to being in one garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deprive wine of its colour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized use in the expression سَلَبَ الصَّهْبَاءَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two wings of a locust or grasshopper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dual lexical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular kind of sheep's milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized traditional term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Possessing coldness; applied especially to a cold plant or to clouds containing hail and cold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjective distinct in form from بَارِدٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Purely or exclusively belonging to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the idiom هِيَ لَكَ بَرْدَةَ نَفْسَهَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Known or familiar to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the idiom بَرْدَةَ يَمِينِي or its variant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A proper name for a ewe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized proper-name use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Indigestion or a stomach disorder caused by unsuitable food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also understood as heaviness of food in the stomach; the term is associated with the stomach becoming cold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle of the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ague or fever accompanied by a cold fit or shivering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Papyrus, a plant used for paper, mats, ropes, sails, and similar products.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective plant noun with a corresponding unit noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Papyrus-like or belonging to papyrus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective, as in a shank compared to a papyrus stalk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An excellent variety of dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized name for a date variety, distinct from بَرْدِيٌّ ‘papyrus’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Feeling cold, chilly, or cool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as possibly post-classical and not found in all lexicons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weakness of the legs caused by hunger or fatigue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beverage that cools the heat of thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive adjective or noun for a cooling drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bread moistened with cold water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A food preparation in which water is poured over the bread.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cold water poured over the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive use describing the cooling water itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything used to make something cold or cool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general substantive use, including a cooling substance or instrument.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collyrium that cools the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized ophthalmic preparation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasant in social intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to either a male or a female in an idiomatic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment without nap, or one that is neither warm nor soft.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of fabric.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mule, horse, or other animal assigned to carry messengers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term first denotes the post conveyance and is extended to the animals used for it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A messenger, especially one travelling by the post.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote a messenger borne on a post animal or a messenger more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A post station or the distance between two such stations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Traditional measures vary in the reports, including six or twelve miles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The course or pace of a camel over a post distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized poetic use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Filings or particles falling from iron and similar material when filed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The product of filing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel or stand used to cool water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word's classical status is reported as uncertain or possibly post-classical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loved, liked, or approved; hence easy and pleasant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective, as in an easy or pleasant life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Constant, continual, permanent, or settled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use, including the expression for a hot wind that continues without abatement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Incumbent, established, owed, or due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a sum or right fixed against someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lean or emaciated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person whose body has become thin or wasted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blunt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a sword or similar implement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharp, cutting, or slaying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary specialized use applied to swords, especially in the plural بَوَارِد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gain acquired without fatigue, including easy profit from a transaction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use; the lexical evidence does not restrict it to any particular object or social class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Colder, chillier, or cooler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cool parts of the day: morning and evening, or their associated shades.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dual expression named for the coolness of those periods.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bull marked with patches of white and black.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive noun or adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The leopard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal name with a feminine form and plural.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cold-related abdominal disorder causing languor or urinary dripping and impairing sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized medical term associated with coldness and dampness inside the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The coldness of damp earth or rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized environmental noun, distinct from ordinary coldness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Arriving or acting when the heat has abated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle of Form IV.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who sends a post messenger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle connected with بَرِيد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A file or rasping instrument.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tool for filing iron and similar materials.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tongue used like a file to annoy, hurt, or revile someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression based on the filing instrument.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause or source of coldness or coolness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to something that cools the body or provides seasonal relief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made or rendered cold, chill, or cool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial form, including water cooled or mixed with snow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tree deprived of its leaves by cold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participial description of cold damage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land upon which hail or snow has fallen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participial description of weather exposure.

cautions: The Qur'anic form بَرْدٌ in 78:24 has two reported interpretations in the supplied lexical evidence: sleep and the coolness of a beverage; both are retained under the form.
The three displayed forms are distinguished by their vocalized lexical identities: بَارِدٌ, بَرَدٌ, and بَرْدٌ.
The Lane citation attached to the sleep interpretation is an internal classical reference to the Qur'anic passage and has not been converted into a modern verse location without QAC support.
